messages:
sara-ux: FYI customer (ACME) seeing intermittent invalid JSON from Go SDK streaming decoder. Happens when using streaming chat API, Go client v0.9.3.

mike-support: can you paste logs / minimal repro? Is this a framing issue? any http proxies in path?

sara-ux: minimal repro below — simple server that streams two JSON objects but splits token boundary across chunks. Go SDK's scanner returns "invalid character '\' after top-level value" sometimes.

sara-ux: curl example:
```bash
curl -v --no-buffer https://api.redwood.local/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sara-ux: server raw chunks (exact bytes):
```
chunk1: {"id":1,"text":"hello, wor
chunk2: ld","meta":{}}
```

josh-runtime: that's consistent with chunked transfer breaking in the middle of a UTF-8/JSON token. net/http should stream bytes as received; decoder/scanner must tolerate token splits. Which Go sdk version? Also what scanner logic are you using?

sara-ux: go-sdk v0.9.3, using client.Stream(ctx, req) and feeding response body into bufio.NewScanner with Scan() to detect newlines and json.Unmarshal on token. Repro code:
```go
resp, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  line := scanner.Text()
  var msg Msg
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &msg); err != nil {
    log.Printf("parse error: %v | raw: %q", err, line)
  }
}
```

mike-support: ahhh Scanner splits on token boundaries by design; when chunks don't include newline you get partial JSON. Do you control server flushes? Should stream send newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) or use length-prefix framing.

sara-ux: customer is using legacy shard that writes raw JSON objects with flushes after arbitrary bytes (not NDJSON). We can't change customer quickly.

josh-runtime: we should harden Go SDK to handle chunked JSON tokens by buffering until a complete JSON object is detected (e.g., track braces depth or use json.Decoder with UseNumber and Decode which reads from stream). I suspect bufio.Scanner + newline assumption is the bug.

mike-support: can you try this client-side patch:
```go
dec := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
for {
  var msg Msg
  if err := dec.Decode(&msg); err == io.EOF {
    break
  } else if err != nil {
    log.Printf("decode err: %v", err)
    break
  }
  handle(msg)
}
```

sara-ux: quick test shows Decode works for this repro — no parse errors. We'll run longer test on customer stream.

infra-bot: ticket #INC-4521 created for customer ACME, severity=P2. Assigned: eng-runtime.

josh-runtime: I'll draft a small patch to the Go SDK stream helper to prefer json.Decoder when content-type is application/json and not newline-delimited. Also add docs and a flag to opt-in backward incompatible behavior.

mike-support: also capture a raw tcpdump if it recurs — need exact chunk boundaries.

sara-ux: uploaded tcpdump to the ticket and ran longer test, decode works. Marking as verified pending prod traffic. :thumbsup:

josh-runtime: opened PR #2894 with tests that simulate chunk splits and NDJSON. cc @mike-support for review.

mike-support: reviewing now, looks reasonable. If we deploy this to hosted API, we should add perf benchmark.

sara-ux: closing loop with customer, they upgraded to patched client and no more errors in 3h sessions. Thanks team!
